event.title: <show-title>The Twilight Saga: New Moon</show-title> <event-type-title>Fan Screening</event-type-title>
event.headline: The next chapter begins
event.description: The supernatural tale of star-crossed lovers continues as the Cullen family flees Forks in order to protect Bella (Kristen Stewart), and the heartbroken high-school senior discovers that vampires aren't the only creatures in town. Realizing that Bella will never be safe as long as he's around, Edward (Robert Pattinson) makes the difficult decision to leave his beloved behind shortly after her 18th birthday. Reeling from her loss, Bella embraces self-destruction after being comforted by Edward's image during a moment of mortal peril. But as heavy-hearted as Bella may be, her friend Jacob (Taylor Lautner) distracts her from her sorrows by helping her renovate a weather-beaten motorbike. When Bella encounters a former adversary with a sizable grudge, she's rescued from harm at the last second by a pack of enormous, ferocious wolves. Subsequently delving into the history of the Quileutes, Bella discovers the secrets of Jacob's tribe while looking forward to a reunion with Edward that may have deadly consequences.

event.description:
Presented in Japanese with English subtitles

A tender and stylish blend of road movie and romance, HIS MOTORBIKE, HER ISLAND is a moving story of love and motorcycles from Japanese cinema magician Nobuhiko Obayashi (HOUSE). Aimless biker Ko finally finds purpose when he falls in love with Miyo, a young woman with an obsession for motorcycles. When she gets her own bike, Ko worries that her ravenous hunger for the road may lead to dire consequences. Shot in an evocative mix of color and black-and-white and threaded with wistful melancholy, feel your heart race on the stunning highways of HIS MOTORBIKE, HER ISLAND.

DCP courtesy of Cult Epics and the American Genre Film Archive

event.title: <show-title>Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai</show-title>
event.headline: Programmed by Mahershala Ali and Bassam Tariq ahead of their new film
event.description:
GHOST DOG: THE WAY OF THE SAMURAI is presented as part of our Mahershala Ali and Bassam Tariq Guest Selects for their new film, YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER.

Jim Jarmusch combines his love for the ice-cool crime dramas of Jean-Pierre Melville and Seijun Suzuki with the philosophical dimensions of samurai mythology for an eccentrically postmodern take on the hit-man thriller.

In one of his defining roles, Forest Whitaker brings a commanding serenity to his portrayal of a Zen contract killer working for a bumbling mob outfit, a modern man who adheres steadfastly to the ideals of the Japanese warrior code, even as chaos and violence spiral around him. Featuring moody cinematography by the great Robby Müller, a mesmerizing score by the Wu-Tang Clan’s RZA, and a host of colorful character actors (including a memorably stone-faced Henry Silva), GHOST DOG: THE WAY OF THE SAMURAI plays like a pop-culture-sampling cinematic mixtape built around a one-of-a-kind tragic hero.

DCP courtesy of Janus Films

event.title: <show-title>Daughters of Darkness</show-title>
event.headline: Delphine Seyrig dazzles in this 1970s erotic lesbian vampire cult classic
event.description:
"I'm just an outmoded character, nothing more. You know, the beautiful stranger, slightly sad, slightly… mysterious… that haunts one place after another."

In the early 1970s, hardboiled crime films were all the rage: CHINATOWN, THE GODFATHER, THE FRENCH CONNECTION dominated the cineplex across the country. But simultaneously, there was another genre on the rise: the erotic lesbian vampire film. From THE VAMPIRE LOVERS to SHIVER OF THE VAMPIRES to VAMPYRES (which you know is queer because of its unconventional spelling), the era was riddled with attempts to cash in on the new lezzie blood-sucking craze. A standout from the red deluge of immortal sapphic stories was DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS, a French, Belgian, and German collaboration helmed by Harry Kümel. When chaotic newlywed couple Valerie (Danielle Ouimet) and Stefan (John Karlen) arrive at a grand hotel on the Ostend seafront during the off-season, they initially seem to be the only guests in residence. That is, until the glamorous and preternaturally youthful Hungarian countess Elizabeth Báthory (Delphine Seyrig) arrives with her icy secretary Ilona (Andrea Rau). The Countess quickly becomes fixated on Valerie, and the dubious honeymoon is thrown into bizarre and erotic disarray.

Featuring an incredible and funky score by François de Roubaix and stunning decadent garments, DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS is a vibe, and it’s so queeeeer. Decadent, alluring, dreamy, and strange, we can’t wait to watch this gorgeous film with you on the big screen as part of Queer Film Theory 10. Come, glamorous darlings, haunt us with your startling visage.

show.title: The Birdcage
show.headline: Robin Williams and Nathan Lane try to play it straight

event.title: <show-title>The Birdcage</show-title>
event.headline: Williams & Lane burst open THE BIRDCAGE in this flamboyant farcical adaptation
event.description:
"My mother always said, 'Live on Fisher Island, get buried in Palm Beach. That way, you'll have the best of Florida.'"

Progress is not a straight line. I mean, I’m not sure it’s a line at all. It seems far more abstract and subjective. Like, listen: in 1996, when THE BIRDCAGE was first released, the idea of a mainstream comedy film with two gay leads (and many more openly queer characters) was controversial. I guess, unfortunately…it still is.

Based on the French farce film LA CAGE AUX FOLLES from 1978, Mike Nichols and Elaine May’s adaptation shifts the action from a drag club in the French Riviera to a drag club in South Beach, Florida…the American Riviera. When Armand Goldman (Robin Williams) learns that his son Val (Dan Futterman) is engaged to the daughter of conservative couple Senator Kevin Keeley (Gene Hackman) and Louise Keeley (Dianne Wiest), he’s put into an impossible situation. Pushed by Val to “straighten” out his life in preparation for meeting his fiancée Barbara’s (Calista Flockhart) parents, Armand struggles to manage his life partner Albert (Nathan Lane) with some dubious assistance from their housemaid Agador (Hank Azaria) and Val’s birth mother Katharine (Christine Brianski). Shenanigans ensue: there’s drag, Fosse, pierced toast, beckoning schmecken, and of course DRAG! WHEW! Grounded by hilarious and deeply heartfelt performances from Williams and Lane, THE BIRDCAGE is an incredible (if sometimes problematic) comedy helmed by the iconic duo of Nichols and May. Immensely quotable and uncomfortably relevant 30 years after its release, THE BIRDCAGE is a classic, and we’re so excited to screen it as part of Queer Film Theory 101!

show.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
show.headline: Every family has its dark secrets

event.title: <show-title>A Tale of Two Sisters</show-title>
event.headline: Sad Girl Cinema Club gets spooky with Kim Jee-woon’s top tier twisted tale
event.description:
A TALE OF TWO SISTERS begins with Su-mi’s (Im Soo-jung) return home from her time away at a mental institution, and her homecoming is less than ideal. Her heavily medicated stepmother Eun-joo (Yum Jung-ah) rules the house, erratic and violent, she often terrified her younger sister Su-yeon (Moon Geun-young). However, their stepmother is not the only one wreaking havoc in their home: the ghost of their mother also haunts them in the evenings, fragmenting the barrier between what is real and what is psychosis.

Korean New Wave spearhead Kim Jee-woon’s diabolical fairy tale is filled with twists and turns. A TALE OF TWO SISTERS is an achingly haunted tale of sisterhood, evil stepmothers, and deadbeat dads. A luscious slow burn, the film to this day remains one of the most affecting Korean horror films of all time.

What is girlhood without a little bit of insanity?

show.title: My Sassy Girl
show.headline: New 4k restoration of the South Korean cult classic romcom

event.title: <show-title>My Sassy Girl</show-title>
event.headline: One of South Korea’s most successful films gets a stunning 4K restoration
event.description:
MY SASSY GIRL is a film that defines the 21st-century romance: based on a series of blog posts about a man’s wacky girlfriend, the film is one of South Korea’s biggest box office hits to this day, and perfectly combines manic pixie dreamgirl energy with sweet earnestness.

Kyun-woo (Cha Tae-hyun) is a do-good type who has never stepped out of line a day in his life. When he meets The Girl (Jun Ji-hyun) drunk as a skunk on a subway platform, his life turns upside down. The two begin to date, much to Kyun-woo’s trepidation, but what he soon realizes is The Girl’s liveliness is masking a deep sadness that he cannot cure.

Jun Ji-hyun was the It Girl of South Korea in the 2000s, and her work with romance master Kwak Jae-yong is some of her best. MY SASSY GIRL is a beautiful blend of comedy and melodrama, and a touching story about two people being in the right place at the wrong time.

show.title: Angel Heart
show.headline: Go down south with Mickey Rourke in this atmospheric thriller.

event.title: <show-title>Angel Heart</show-title>
event.headline: It will scare you to your very soul
event.description:
Veterans of the British TV commercials industry made some pretty strong contributions to the fright-film scene between the late '70s and early '90s: Ridley Scott gave us ALIEN, Adrian Lyne helmed JACOB'S LADDER, and Alan Parker got scary with ANGEL HEART.

Based on William Hjortsberg's novel Fallen Angel and set in the '50s, the film follows P.I. Harry Angel (Mickey Rourke) as he ventures into an occult underworld in search of a missing singer named Johnny Favorite, at the behest of Robert De Niro's mysterious Louis Cyphre. The film became notorious at the time of its release for a blood-drenched sex scene between Angel and Favorite's daughter, Epiphany Proudfoot – particularly since she was played by Lisa Bonet, star of the wholesome TV hit The Cosby Show – that had to be trimmed to avoid an X rating.

Today, ANGEL HEART stands as one of the most darkly stylish horror films of the late '80s, a period when studios had otherwise largely abandoned the genre in the wake of the slasher boom. Its sinister charm is best appreciated on the big screen, so come and witness the 4K restoration!

show.title: Ginger Snaps
show.headline: They don't call it the curse for nothing

event.title: <show-title>Ginger Snaps</show-title>
event.headline: The ultimate feminist werewolf parable
event.description: One of the dumbest prejudices perpetuated by the world is that menstrual cycles turn women into monsters. That conceit is what makes GINGER SNAPS so powerful. The Fitzgerald sisters (Katharine Isabelle and Emily Perkins) are death-obsessed high school goths who create violent art projects while battling the popular kids. But everything changes when someone’s period – and a werewolf – enters the picture. Written by Karen Walton as a feminist werewolf parable, GINGER SNAPS is an essential Y2K ripper that has lost none of its freshness, relevance, or bite over the past two decades.

show.title: Jacob's Ladder (1990)
show.headline: The most frightening thing about Jacob's nightmare is that it's not a dream

event.title: <show-title>Jacob's Ladder (1990)</show-title>
event.headline: Adrian Lyne's PTSD nightmare, newly restored.
event.description:
After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness. (Rialto Pictures)

This restoration was completed by ROUNDABOUT – USA from the original negative scanned and restored in 4K. The color grading and restoration was supervised by Adrian Lyne. This project was brought to you by STUDIOCANAL and supervised by Delphine Roussel and Jean-Pierre Boiget.

CASTRATION MOVIE is a multi-part postmodern epic by visionary auteur Louise Weard.

Circle (Lex Walton) tries to leave a trans separatist cult in New York.

CASTRATION MOVIE ANTHOLOGY ii. THE BEST OF BOTH WORLDS was shot entirely on location in New York City and features a cast headlined by Lex Walton (POMP AND CIRCUMSTANCE), Ivy Wolk (ANORA), Lea Rose Sebastianis (IN A VIOLENT NATURE), Jack Haven (I SAW THE TV GLOW), Hesse Deni (BRAIN DEATH), Theda Hammel (STRESS POSITIONS), Alexandra McVicker (THE SERPENT'S SKIN), Betsey Brown (ACTORS), and Peter Vack (WWW.RACHELORMONT.COM), amongst a mix of other emerging talent and weird and wonderful cameos.

show.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
show.headline: The master would not approve

event.title: <show-title>Manos: The Hands of Fate</show-title>
event.headline: The master would not approve
event.description:
Q: Are we not men?
A: WE ARE MANOS!

Mike (Harold P. Warren) and Maggie (Diane Mahree) are on a road trip with their daughter and family dog. But they take a wrong turn and wind up at a lodge inhabited by a polygamous pagan cult! The family finds themselves in the middle of a power struggle between caretaker Torgo (John Reynolds), cult leader The Master (Tom Neyman), and two warring factions of the Master’s wives. The sole directorial effort of Texas fertilizer salesman Warren, MANOS: THE HANDS OF FATE is an absurdist masterpiece. Prepare to exit the planet.

event.headline: The Dr. Seuss-penned Technicolor musical fantasia on 35mm
event.description: In theory, Parental Advisory stickers and ratings system are meant to protect children from prurient and upsetting content designed to warp young minds into mush. Clearly, they missed the mark with this dose of nightmare fuel, the Stanley Kramer-produced live-action Dr. Seuss-penned musical fantasia, THE 5,000 FINGERS OF DR. T. Originally conceived as a parable to post-war fascism, DR. T finds young music enthusiast Bart pitted in a dream realm against the eponymous taskmaster who has designs to have 500 boys play his multi-keyed piano. (Jake Isgar)

marketStrings.value: The personal closed captioning device displays feature film dialogue and other audio in the form of English-language text for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing.

The descriptive audio headset provides individuals who are blind or have low vision with an English-language narration of the details of the feature presentation that can't be understood by the soundtrack alone.

Upon request at the box office, we provide assistive listening headsets with amplified audio for those individuals who are hard of hearing. For guests who prefer to use their own hearing aids, neck loops, or cochlear implants, our assistive listening headsets have a 3.5mm headphone jack to connect to those devices.

In order to ensure the highest quality experience for all guests, you may not enter a movie after it has started. We’d love to see you up to 30 minutes early. Running late? No worries, we will happily exchange your ticket for a different showtime or a raincheck to a future show.

sessionAttributes.name: Infinity Vision
sessionAttributes.description: Infinity Vision is Disney's rigorous Premium Large Format certification, guaranteeing you an exceptional film presentation. Screens must be at least 45 feet wide, outfitted with Immersive sound like Dolby Atmos or 7.1, and brightness levels should reach either 14 footlamberts in 2D and/or 6 footlamberts in 3D.
